description: PREMISES: Smart Meter Measurements is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Emilio José Palacios-García (Associatie KU Leuven). The PREMISES Smart Meter Measurement dataset contains electrical consumption data, as well as water and gas consumption when available, for 3 households in Belgium. The measurements were obtained using the local P1-Port interface and the open software tool: a href="https://github.com/ejpalacios/p1-reader-premises" https://github.com/ejpalacios/p1-reader-premises /a . Coverage: national (BE); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: CSV. Size stated: 3407. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
